name: clinicadentalbravopr.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But axios 0.21.4 has known flaws.
lesson: Check front-end library versions against a known-flaw list on every release, and upgrade the ones that are flagged.
summary: www.clinicadentalbravopr.com scores 77 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 32 pass. Fix first: elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 12 elements on /, /servicios, /general-4, for example #comp-m3eitzyu50label. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: axios 0.21.4 has known flaws
fix.evidence: axios 0.21.4 (banner of /_partials/wix-thunderbolt/dist/clientWorker.fbd4140d.bundle.min.js): 24 known flaws, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2023-45857, CVE-2025-27152, CVE-2026-25639. Axios does not correctly normalize hostnames when checking…
fix.fix: Upgrade axios to 1.6.8 or later. A major upgrade changes behavior, so retest the pages that use it.

vars.name: axios
vars.summary: Axios does not correctly normalize hostnames when checking NO_PROXY rules, causing requests to loopback addresses with a trailing dot (loca….

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 5 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 5 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /servicios, /general-4, /contacto and 1 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 5 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:description, og:image
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 166 ms
Every external link that was checked answered
